columns.mental_template|facilities|fackey: Facility key. Unique ID for each facility.
columns.mental_template|facilities|rsource: Referral source. Category of referral origin.
columns.mental_template|facilities|envstress: Environmental stress level. Mild, Moderate, or Severe.
columns.mental_template|facilities|lifeimpact: Life impact level. Mild, Moderate, or Severe.
columns.mental_template|facilities|seasonpat: Seasonal pattern. Summer, Winter, or Variable.
columns.mental_template|facilities|leglissue: Legal issue status. Resolved, Ongoing, or Pending.
columns.mental_template|facilities|ssystemchg: Support system change. Improved, Declined, or Variable.
columns.mental_template|facilities|support_and_r: JSON object storing support plans, services, emergency contact count, and community resource availability.
Crisis plan status. Not Needed, Needs Update, or In Place.
Safety plan status. Not Needed, Needs Update, or In Place.
Support services list. Comma-separated service categories or empty.
Emergency contact count. Number from 0 to 10.
Community resource availability. Limited, Adequate, or Comprehensive.
columns.mental_template|assessmentsymptomsandris: Unique record ID for assessment symptoms and risk.
Suicidal ideation category: Passive, Active, Plan, Intent.
Self-harm status: Past, Recent, or Current.
JSON object with anxiety, depression, and symptom scores.
GAD-7 anxiety severity: Mild, Moderate, or Severe.
PHQ-9 depression severity: Mild, Moderate, Moderately Severe, or Severe.
Array of 8 decimal symptom scores, each 1.0-10.0.
columns.mental_template|treatmentbasics|encref: MH reference code, 8 characters, mostly unique.
columns.mental_template|treatmentbasics|therapy_: Therapy change type inside therapy_details JSON.
Therapy engagement level inside therapy_details JSON.
Therapy duration in months inside therapy_details JSON.
columns.mental_template|patients|patkey: Patient unique identifier. Code P + 6 digits.
columns.mental_template|patients|patgender: Patient gender. Categories F, M, Other.
columns.mental_template|patients|pateth: Patient ethnicity. Categories African, Asian, Caucasian, Hispanic, Other.
columns.mental_template|patients|edulevel: Patient education level. Categories High School, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate, Other.
columns.mental_template|patients|empstat: Patient employment status. Categories Employed, Unemployed, Disabled, Retired, Student.
columns.mental_template|patients|maristat: Patient marital status. Categories Married, Single, Divorced, Widowed.
columns.mental_template|patients|livingarr: Patient living arrangement. Categories Alone, Family, Group Home, Homeless, Partner.
columns.mental_template|patients|insurtype: Patient insurance type. Categories Private, Medicare, Medicaid.
columns.mental_template|patients|insurstat: Patient insurance status. Categories Approved, Denied, Pending.
columns.mental_template|patients|disabstat: Patient disability status. Categories Pending, Permanent, Temporary.
columns.mental_template|patients|housestable: Patient housing stability. Categories Stable, At Risk, Unstable, Homeless.
columns.mental_template|patients|cultfactor: Patient cultural factor. Categories Language, Family, Beliefs, Multiple.
columns.mental_template|patients|stigmaimp: Patient stigma impact level. Categories Mild, Moderate, Severe.
columns.mental_template|patients|finstress: Patient financial stress level. Categories Mild, Moderate, Severe.
columns.mental_template|patients|clinleadref: Clinical lead referral identifier. Code C + 4 digits.
columns.mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|txoutk: Unique integer identifier for treatment outcome record.
columns.mental_template|treatmentoutcomes|txref: Integer reference identifier for treatment episode.
columns.mental_template|assessmentbasics|atype: Assessment type: Emergency, Follow-up, Initial, Routine.
columns.mental_template|assessmentbasics|amethod: Assessment method: In-person, Telehealth, Phone, Self-report.
columns.mental_template|assessmentbasics|alang: Assessment language: English, Spanish, Chinese, French, Other.
